programs.title: Andrea Bocelli: Because I Believe
programs.desc: Silhouette of a famous opera singer.The camera follows Andrea Bocelli not only behind the scenes, but also off stage to show his private life - among his family and closest friends.

programs.title: The Night Before Christmas In Wonderland
programs.desc: One day, Santa Claus receives a letter from the Queen of Hearts.Together with his faithful team of reindeer, he sets off to Karina Czarów to deliver a gift for her.However, he quickly gets into serious trouble.

programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programs.title: Creator
programs.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.

programs.title: French Courier from Liberty, Kansas Evening Sun
programs.desc: The 20th-century fictional French town of Ennui-sur-Blasé is the headquarters of "Kurier Francuski", a magazine published by American emigrants.When a respected editor, Kansas native Arthur Howitzer Jr (Bill Murray), dies, the entire team gathers to write an obituary.Their memories make up four colorful stories.Herbsaint Sazerac (Owen Wilson), an avid cyclist, recalls dark stories related to the city, showing its dangerous alleys.J.K.L.Berensen (Tilda Swinton) presents the story of an insane painter, Moses Rosenthaler (Benicio del Toro), who creates from behind prison bars.A brilliant artist is involved in an affair with a guard and his muse (Lea Seydoux).An art dealer, Julian Cadazio (Adrien Brody), tries to make money from his paintings.Lucinda Krementz (Frances McDormand) tells the story of a fiery student rebellion led by Zeffirelli (Timothée Chalamet).It is also a story of beautiful love and tragic death on the barricades.Roebuck Wright (Jeffrey Wright) presents a story about drugs, kidnappings and refined cuisine, and its hero will be Lieutenant Nescaffier (Steve Park).Another visual masterpiece from Wes Anderson is a tribute to old-style journalism.The elaborate, nostalgic anthology is inspired by the famous weekly "The New Yorker" and the personalities who made up its editorial staff.

programs.title: Future Diva
programs.desc: A story about women with an unquenchable thirst for freedom who decide to work in the porn industry.Ilona is among them.
